label: main season
summary: E1 is indirect, class 4 evidence: an informant who works in the area reports an armed-group camp and that land beside the stream has not been used since. This is a target under the national criteria; technical survey is unavailable, so clearance is the permitted next step. This is a recommendation for sign-off, not a final decision.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: A woodcutter said people stopped using the land beside the stream after an armed group camped there around 1997, and nobody has used it since.
E1.note: The report of an armed-group camp and subsequent non-use suggests possible contamination but does not confirm EO; the informant works in the area and reports land-use history firsthand.
